doc: PROFILE.md 7.1: '**`readers.las` `ignore_missing_vlrs`.** Lets the reader carry on past a VLR it cannot use instead of refusing the file. By default `readers.las` refuses a file whose VLR block it cannot walk to the end — a record header that runs off the end of the file, or a record whose declared payload length runs past the start of the point data — and writes no output. With the option set the reader stops reading VLRs at that record, keeps the ones it already has, and returns the file's points normally.'  apps/index.rst: 'The ``--drivers`` and ``--options`` switches can tell you more about particular drivers and their options'.  Both options are asserted by PRESENCE -- each regex searches the whole option array for an element whose `name` is the option.  Neither the position of `ignore_missing_vlrs` in the array nor the help string the reader registers it under is asserted: no document states either, so an implementation that appends the option under wording of its own conforms.  At 2.6.0 the reader carries `ignore_vlr` and not `ignore_missing_vlrs`.
